outputs:

   - Time = 518 minutes = 518 / 60 hours ≈ 8.633 hours

   - Distance = 284 miles

5. **Calculate the total time John spent traveling:**
   - Total Time = Time (first part) + Time (waiting) + Time (second part) + Time (last part)

   - Time spent in last 804 hours = 804 - 518 - 0.446 - 3.55 = 804 - 521.996 ≈ 282.004 hours

Final Answer: 282.004
